mapper.select: SELECT b.contract_date AS field1, sum( a.sale_qty ) AS field2 FROM ks_contract_details a LEFT JOIN ks_contract b ON a.contract_id = b.id WHERE b.contract_date >= #{start} AND b.contract_date < #{end} AND b.state != 'draft' GROUP BY field1

SELECT to_char(b.contract_date,'YYYY-MM') AS field1, sum( a.sale_qty ) AS field2 FROM ks_contract_details a LEFT JOIN ks_contract b ON a.contract_id = b.id WHERE b.contract_date >= #{start} AND b.contract_date < #{end} AND b.state != 'draft' GROUP BY field1

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.contract_date + INTERVAL '1 day' * (7 - EXTRACT(DOW FROM b.contract_date)::int))::int * 100 + EXTRACT(WEEK FROM b.contract_date + INTERVAL '1 day' * (7 - EXTRACT(DOW FROM b.contract_date)::int))::int AS field1, sum( a.sale_qty ) AS field2 FROM ks_contract_details a LEFT JOIN ks_contract b ON a.contract_id = b.id WHERE b.contract_date >= #{start} AND b.contract_date < #{end} AND b.state != 'draft' GROUP BY field1
